decisions.reason: ERC-721C marketplace whitelisting changes how the existing $10 secondary royalty is enforced, but it does not change the Small Block pool's funding sources, contribution rules, ticket rules, or draw behavior.
The approved FAQ state does not specify the NFT token standard or royalty-enforcement mechanism, and its existing secondary-royalty statements remain valid without a required copy change.
Selecting ERC-721C to whitelist marketplaces and enforce royalties does not change which book, referral code, badges, or ticket state transfers to a purchaser.
The secondary-market royalty-enforcement mechanism has no effect on optional PDF download availability, labeling, or presentation.
The source decision concerns enforcement of the $10 royalty on secondary sales and does not alter any primary-mint revenue allocation.
ERC-721C marketplace controls do not alter badge triggers, milestone thresholds, or the on-chain badge destination.
Choosing ERC-721C instead of standard ERC-721 does not change the confirmed deployment network, which remains Base.
The secondary royalty-enforcement mechanism does not change the amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or delivery of commissions for coded primary-mint referrals.
The ERC-721C decision is unrelated to the deferred Discord community-server requirement.
Marketplace whitelisting and secondary-royalty enforcement do not change fiat buyers' provisioned-wallet, dashboard, commission, ticket, prize, or email access behavior.
The source confirms enforcement of a $10 secondary-sale royalty but does not change the $15 primary mint price or its advertised commitment.
The NFT remains an unlimited-mint ebook; ERC-721C is selected specifically as the secondary-royalty enforcement mechanism and does not change the candidate's product type or supply model.
